provenance: Codex-assisted synthetic-fixture authoring and per-record inspection; not librarian annotation or an independent expert judgment.
criterion: Description supplies evidence of lived experience or community response to river flooding in Appalachia. The two export duplicates count as separate source records. Insufficient descriptions are not positives.

records.rationale: Residents describe a flood and collective recovery in Appalachia.
evidence: Residents of an Appalachian community describe the river flood of 1977. They organized boat rescues, shared meals and repaired the school after the water receded.
records.reviewed_text: Residents of an Appalachian community describe the river flood of 1977. They organized boat rescues, shared meals and repaired the school after the water receded.

records.rationale: Captions document residents' experience and relief work.
evidence: Photographs show an Appalachian community during a river flood. Captions identify families moving furniture upstairs and volunteers distributing clean water.
records.reviewed_text: Photographs show an Appalachian community during a river flood. Captions identify families moving furniture upstairs and volunteers distributing clean water.
